title: Ourea Events legacy event page — Dragon's Back Race history, ranges and navigation basis
claims: The race was revived by Ourea Events in 2012, twenty years after the legendary 1992 race in which the inaugural 'dragons' first took on Wales' wild, trackless, remote mountain terrain.
The route follows the rugged spine of Wales north to south, crossing the Brecon Beacons, Cambrian Mountains, Rhinogs, Moelwyns and Snowdonia.
Navigation is unmarked and self-supported within race safety frameworks, demanding constant decision-making, mountain judgement and relentless forward momentum over six punishing days.
The legacy page describes six days from Conwy Castle to Cardiff Castle, 380 km with an average daily distance of 63 km, and an older ascent figure of 17,400 m.
